You are in a kitchen. A typical one. You begin to take stock of what's here.

You can see a fridge. As if things weren't amazing enough already, you can even see an oven. You make out a table. On the table you can make out a cookbook and a knife. You can see a counter. Here's a stove. The stove is conventional. But there isn't a thing on it.

thought: I will examine the cookbook on the table to find the recipe.

---------

  fry the yellow bell pepper
  dice the orange bell pepper
  fry the orange bell pepper
  slice the carrot
  roast the carrot
  slice the pork chop
  roast the pork chop
  prepare meal
